name: Batatais (Brazil)
description: Gyronny of blue and red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms with a scroll reading BATATAIS.
history: Batatais is a municipality in the state of São Paulo, Brazil, nicknamed the town with the most beautiful gardens and proclaimed a tourist resort by State Law No. 8,993 of 23 December 1994.

features.role: municipal arms with a mural crown, a shield with the Cross of the Order of Christ and waves, reading BATATAIS
